items.text:
After getting back from a successful scarping mission i let my captain rest for 6 hours.... died from hunger
After reloading i tried again after eating.... died from overheating
one last reload and 3 hours less sleep woke up to being on the verge of dying from hypotheromia 
MF when i just played groundhog day
items.text_zh:
在一次成功的打捞任务回来后，我让我的船长休息了6个小时……结果饿死了
重新读档后，我这次先吃了东西再试……结果过热死了
最后一次读档，少睡3个小时，醒来时发现自己已经濒临体温过低而死
妈的，我这是在玩《土拨鼠之日》吗

observations.description: 休息后角色因饥饿死亡
observations.evidence: let my captain rest for 6 hours.... died from hunger
observations.evidence_zh: 让我的船长休息了 6 个小时……结果饿死了
